summary: 100% accurate species image matching (Garzas, Tinguas, Colibríes, Patos, Saúco, Capulí, Aliso, Enea, etc.) and double-click to hide node feature. Double-clicking any 3D node smoothly hides it and dynamically recalculates active connectivity topology across remaining nodes. Includes 'Restablecer Nodos Ocultos' button.
